title: Runner report
description: What the runner writes at the end of one round. It is the runner's own account, and the driver holds each part against what it observes independently: `evaluation_digest` against the dated evaluator's body for the run as the round found it; `dispatched` against the packets its stub workers received; each applied integration against the tree's bytes; the records and `in_flight` against the run file. What only the report can say — why unattended work was refused, what a restart found — is said here in closed terms.

evaluation_digest.description: The dated evaluator's `digest` of the body `evaluate` returned for the run file as this round found it. The round dispatched from that body and no other.

integrations.description: Every change a worker proposed, in the order the integrator took it up. Changes to one path are taken up one at a time, each against the path's bytes at its turn.

reconciliations.description: One row for every attempt the round found in `in_flight` when it started, before anything was dispatched.

terminal_claimed.description: Whether the runner reports the plan's terminal claims as satisfied for the run as the round left it.

integration.description: One proposed change and what the integrator did with it. The row is the integration's identity: this attempt's change to this path, from this base, to these bytes.

result_digest.description: sha256 of the path's bytes after the change.

reconciliation.description: What the round found of an attempt a stopped round left in flight, and what it did. `found`: the attempt's changes are in the tree, a result exists but its changes are not in the tree, or no result exists. `disposition`: dispatched again under the same attempt id, recorded under that id, or still held in flight under that id.

mode_refusal.description: Present exactly when the run requests unattended mode and the plan's qualification node is not accepted. `because` is the evaluator's list of reasons it rejected that node. Nothing is dispatched, in either mode.

packet_digest.description: sha256 of the packet file's bytes.
